description: Build a dependency resolver with cycle detection for a package manager
prompt: Write a Python module with: (1) class `Package` with name: str and deps: list[str], (2) `resolve_order(packages: dict[str, Package]) -> list[str]` that returns a topological install order, (3) `detect_cycles(packages: dict[str, Package]) -> list[list[str]]` that finds all dependency cycles. If resolve_order encounters a cycle, raise `CyclicDependencyError` with the cycle path. Include test_resolve_order() testing: linear chain, diamond dependency, cycle detection, missing dependency error. Include test_detect_cycles() testing: no cycles returns empty, single cycle, multiple independent cycles.
expected_behavior: Topological sort for acyclic graphs, CyclicDependencyError with path for cyclic graphs, all cycles enumerated

validation_criteria.l4: test_resolve_order() and test_detect_cycles() pass all assertions
validation_criteria.l5: Correct topological ordering, cycle detection finds ALL cycles, handles diamond deps
